QUOTE: "`ServerDataOperator` (`app/database/operator/server_data_operator/index.ts:40`) is a runtime mixin chain" and "**Mechanism:** `mix(...)` in `app/utils/mix.ts` is a `reduce` that applies each mixin function to the previous class, so each handler is a subclass of the one before it."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says ServerDataOperator is built via the `mix(...)` helper applying handler mixins on top of ServerDataOperatorBase, rather than declaring the handlers itself.
